metric_definitions.f_true_log: Finite-sample perturbation ratio Var(delta_log)/Var(log s_obs); can exceed 1.0 when Cov(log s_0, delta_log) < 0.
metric_definitions.f_pop_log: Bounded [0,1] population log-scale scatter share Var(delta_log)/(Var(log s_0) + Var(delta_log)).
metric_definitions.f_pop_lin: Bounded [0,1] same-scale linear-s population scatter share Var(a)*E[s_0^2] / (Var(a)*E[s_0^2] + E[a]^2*Var(s_0)).
metric_definitions.f_adj_pop_lin: Baseline-adjusted linear-s population scatter share 1 - (1 - f_pop_lin)*R2_shape_0.
